description: This file defines the 'Shape' class in the TensorFlow Java API, representing tensor shapes, including known, unknown, scalar, and N-dimensional shapes, with methods for creation, comparison, and string representation.

classes.name: Shape
classes.description: Represents the possibly partially known shape of a tensor, supporting shape creation, comparison, and description.

methods.name: unknown
methods.description: Creates a Shape representing an unknown number of dimensions.

methods.name: scalar
methods.description: Creates a Shape representing a scalar value.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates an N-dimensional Shape with specified sizes, where -1 indicates an unknown dimension.

methods.name: numDimensions
methods.description: Returns the number of dimensions, or -1 if unknown.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the specified dimension, or -1 if unknown.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the Shape for debugging.
